label: common_2070_rival_02
text: I’m so glad we juuust managed to get everything\nready for the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Academy Ace Tournament[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2070_rival_09
text: Oh yeah—that’s what we decided to officially\nname the tournament! It’s a good name, right?\r\nFitting, memorable?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2070_rival_10
text: But then Arven went and said we should call it\nthe “School Battle Brawl”...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2070_rival_11
text: And then even Director Clavell got into calling it\nthat, so now I’m just like...agh![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2070_rival_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Anyway, how you feelin’, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?
In the
mindset
to do
some winning?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2070_rival_04a
text: There’s that enthusiasm! Show us what a\nChampion’s made of![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2070_rival_04b
text: Pffft, ha! The old “nooo, I’m still sleepy” routine?\nGood joke![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2070_rival_05
text: It’s so cool that La Primera’s gonna make a guest\nappearance, thanks to your hard work![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2070_rival_06
text: I wish I didn’t have my hands full with all the\nbehind-the-scenes admin stuff.\c\nI won’t even get to do any battling myself...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2070_rival_07
text: But I’ll seize the chance to do some objective\nresearch into what makes YOU so good![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_2070_rival_08
text: Anyway, let’s get going. I’ll meet you at the\nfront desk in the entrance hall! No stalling![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
